description: Nothing on this statement is wrong, but four lines look wrong. Before March 2026 the member had paid $300 out of pocket, $100 of it toward the deductible. Claim 1's biopsy takes the last $50 of the deductible plus 20% of the rest, so its share is above 20%, and claim 2's eye exam was approved at $24, below the $40 copay, so the member pays $24 and the plan $0. Claim 3 shows the same physical therapy service on two dates one day apart, each with its own $30 copay, and claim 4's X-ray of the chest was billed at five times its approved amount. A careful reviewer should report no errors.

decoys.rule: Plan's stated design (evidence of coverage, note C1): the year's in-network deductible is paid first, then 20% coinsurance on the rest of the approved amount
decoys.note: The biopsy took the last $50 of the deductible plus 20% of the rest, so a share above 20% is correct

decoys.rule: Plan's stated design (evidence of coverage): when the plan-approved amount is less than the copay, the member pays the approved amount and the plan pays $0
decoys.note: The eye exam was approved at $24, below the $40 copay, so the member pays $24 and the plan $0

decoys.rule: Not a duplicate: exact duplicates must have matching service dates (CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch. 1 §120.2, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf); each visit has its own copay (note K1)
decoys.note: The same therapy service on two dates one day apart is two visits, each with its own $30 copay

decoys.rule: A provider's charge is its own fee; cost sharing is figured from the plan-approved amount (CMS sample MSN, https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Medicare-General-Information/MSN/Downloads/Sample-Part-B-Medicare-Summary-Notice.pdf; plan's evidence of coverage)
decoys.note: The X-ray of the chest was billed at five times its approved amount; the member still pays only the $25 imaging copay

sources.what: This plan's stated deductible is paid first, then its 20% coinsurance; a copay may not exceed the cost of the service (its plan-approved amount)
sources.source: eCFR, 42 CFR 422.111(b)(2), Disclosure requirements (deductibles, coinsurance, copayments), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-B/part-422/subpart-C/section-422.111; eCFR, 42 CFR 422.100(f)(6) (copay no greater than the cost of the service), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-B/part-422/subpart-C/section-422.100

sources.what: Two lines can be exact duplicates only if their dates of service match
sources.source: CMS, Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04), ch. 1, §120.2 Exact Duplicates, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf

sources.what: Medicare covers medically necessary outpatient physical therapy, with no yearly limit on what it pays
The amount a provider charged is its own fee; the approved amount is what the provider can be paid
sources.source: CMS, What is in your Medicare Summary Notice (sample Part B notice), https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Medicare-General-Information/MSN/Downloads/Sample-Part-B-Medicare-Summary-Notice.pdf
